text: 5:27 < Nl — E < O ... EXT. HOME VILLAGE HILLSIDE SUNRISE ON THE SAGEBRUSH KANIKSU (V.O.) It's so quiet here... YOUNG BOY and OLDER SISTER crouch hidden in a bush. She has an unadorned arrow knocked on her simple bow, at the ready. KANIKSU I said it's so quiet here. CASCADE shh. The girl slowly rises from her knee, silently raising the bow into position and drawing tension on the arrow in one smooth fluid motion. Her brother, scratching at the dry soil with a stick, doesn't notice. KANIKSU I'm bored. The girl's eyes are locked in on a game bird - a grouse of some kind, large enough to call their hunting trip a success. She has no time for her brother's whims. KANIKSU Cas. I said I'm bored. Cas.
